$comment: Reviewed inputs to the instance's third-party notices -- #1096. scripts/check-third-party-notices.mjs reads this file (SERVERS[].inputs); nothing else does.

noLicenceFile: packages in the instance's distributed closure whose installed tarball carries NO licence file. The generator fails closed on such a package (NOT003) unless an entry here, keyed by name@version, says where its notice comes from instead, so a version bump fails closed again until somebody re-reads the new version. 'upstream' is text read from the project's own repository at a named commit; 'licenceText' adds the canonical licence text this repository already pins (LIC005), once, at the end of the document.

@ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.56.why: The tarball holds its build, its source, its README and its CHANGELOG and no LICENSE, where its siblings from the same repository and release (@ai-sdk/provider 4.0.24, ai 7.0.130) each ship one. Its manifest says Apache-2.0 and names the vercel/ai repository; the text below is that repository's root LICENSE at the commit the tag @ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.56 names, byte-identical to the LICENSE @ai-sdk/provider 4.0.24 ships.
